# Assumptions: luyten_early_oa

<!-- Generated by `oai assumptions luyten_early_oa --write` from assumptions.toml. Do not edit. -->

6 confirmed · 13 assumed · 7 open

## Confirmed (6)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.knees` | `both` (choices: both, right) | Mahmoudian 2021 abstract: 1,315 knees (27%) met the criteria; the unit is the knee |  |
| `luyten.koos_cutoff` | `85` | Mahmoudian 2021 abstract: 'two out of four KOOS subscales equal or less than 85' |  |
| `luyten.koos_min` | `2` | Luyten 2018 and Mahmoudian 2021: two of four subscales (pain, symptoms, function in daily living, quality of life) |  |
| `model.corstr` | `exchangeable` (choices: exchangeable, independence) | Lo 2018 Methods, Statistical analysis: GEE with an exchangeable correlation structure |  |
| `model.covariates` | `["age", "sex", "bmi"]` | Spec: Model 1 adjusts for age, sex and BMI, the covariates of Lo 2018 and the other crepitus analyses |  |
| `periods.horizon` | `10` (choices: 06, 10) | Spec: outcomes by 48 (V06) and 96 months (V10); Mahmoudian 2021 reports 48 and 96 months |  |

## Assumed (13)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cohort.cohorts` | `all` (choices: all, progression_incidence) | Mahmoudian 2021 abstract: 'the OAI comprises data of 4796 men and women'; no cohort restriction stated |  |
| `cohort.reading_project` | `15` | Lo 2018 Methods: central readers; Project 15 reproduces the 877 baseline right-knee SOA exclusion exactly |  |
| `exposure.s2_coding` | `any` (choices: any, levels) | Within about 1,100 knees five S2 levels are sparse; any = at least rarely (KOOS S2 >= 1) vs never |  |
| `luyten.adl_source` | `womac_function` (choices: womac_function, omit) | The OAI release has no KOOS function-in-daily-living subscale; it is the 17 WOMAC function items, so KOOS ADL = 100 - V00WOMADL{side} x 100 / 68 | omit: count only pain, symptoms and quality of life, still needing two |
| `luyten.kl_source` | `project15` (choices: project15, outcomes99) | Baseline tibiofemoral KL from the Project 15 central reading, as in the other crepitus analyses; Mahmoudian 2021 does not say (abstract) | outcomes99: V99E?XIOA = 1 is KL >= 2 at baseline, 2-9 is KL 0-1; it covers knees Project 15 did not read |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope` | `knee` (choices: knee, either) | A knee-level analysis: the knee's own replacement counts (soa_status treats any value but 'either' as the knee's side) |  |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_timing` | `by_visit_days` (choices: by_visit_days) | A replacement counts from the first outcome visit whose V##VISDYS is on or after the replacement day |  |
| `outcomes.missing_visit_days` | `nominal_month` (choices: nominal_month) | When a participant has no V##VISDYS for an outcome visit, the replacement-timing check uses the visit's nominal month (config/oai.toml [visits]) in days |  |
| `outcomes.pain_baseline_item` | `P01KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods quote the 12-month frequent-pain question; screening-visit item, as in analyses/lo2022_walking |  |
| `outcomes.pain_followup_item` | `V{visit}KP{side}12CV` | Lo 2018 Methods: symptoms at 12, 24, 36, 48 months; AllClinical follow-up item |  |
| `outcomes.roa_replacement` | `event` (choices: event, ignore) | Replacing a KL 0-1 knee during follow-up implies it progressed; soa_status already counts a replacement as SOA | ignore: the ROA outcome uses OUTCOMES99 incidence only, so a replaced knee is usually unknown after its last reading |
| `outcomes.roa_source` | `outcomes99` (choices: readings, outcomes99) | kXR_SQ_BU_Descrip.pdf sections 1.3 and Appendix B recommend the OUTCOMES99 summary variables (V99E?XIOA) over merging reading projects by hand | Earliest visit with KL >= 2 from Projects 15, 37 and 43, carried forward; readings (Project 15, same visit) is refused past 48 months |
| `outcomes.roa_unread` | `unknown` (choices: unknown, no_roa) | OUTCOMES99 'no incidence' (V99E?XIOA = 2) holds only while the knee was read; V99E?XNOA gives the last visit with no ROA | unknown: after that visit (and between it and an incident visit) ROA is missing; no_roa: taken as absent (the first version of this analysis) |

## Open (7)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `horizon.selection` | `known_or_case` (choices: known_or_case, complete) | Spec decision 5: L3 keeps people whose outcome at the horizon is known or who became cases earlier | known_or_case keeps cases who left and drops non-cases who left (favours cases); complete keeps only people with a known outcome at the horizon. Lo 2018's four-year table counted missing outcomes as non-events. L2 is the censoring-robust estimate. |
| `luyten.koos_missing` | `not_met` (choices: not_met, exclude) | Mahmoudian 2021 (abstract) does not say how a missing KOOS subscale was handled | not_met: a missing subscale is not <= 85, so the knee needs two of the others; exclude: the knee leaves the KL 0-1 denominator |
| `luyten.sign_missing` | `not_met` (choices: not_met, exclude) | Mahmoudian 2021 (abstract) does not say how a missing crepitus or joint-line tenderness exam was handled | not_met: a missing sign is absent, so another sign can still meet the criterion; exclude: a knee with any sign missing and none present leaves the denominator |
| `outcomes.replacement_counts` | `adjudicated_or_self_report` (choices: adjudicated_or_self_report) | oai.derive.knee.REPLACEMENT_STATUS_COUNTS (from Lo 2022 p.1661): V99E*RPCF of 1 (self-reported) or 3 (adjudicated, confirmed), or RPSN = 1 (seen on a follow-up X-ray). Lo 2018 says only 'any participant with a knee arthroplasty' | A counted replacement with no day count (V99E*DAYS blank) never becomes SOA at a follow-up visit |
| `outcomes.roa_definition` | `kl2` (choices: kl2, kl2_jsn) | OUTCOMES99 offers incident KL >= 2 (V99E?XIOA) and incident KL >= 2 with JSN (V99E?XIOAN); Lo 2018 used KL >= 2 |  |
| `outcomes.roa_rule` | `same_visit` (choices: same_visit, ever) | Lo 2018 Methods: ROA = tibiofemoral KL >= 2; whether ROA is carried forward once seen is not stated |  |
| `outcomes.soa_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, known_false) | Lo 2018 does not say whether SOA is missing or known absent when one component (pain or KL) is missing | known_false: no frequent pain (or KL < 2) rules SOA out even if the other component is missing |

## Variants

| Variant | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `adl_omitted` | `luyten.adl_source = omit` | KOOS criterion over pain, symptoms and quality of life only |
| `horizon_complete` | `horizon.selection = complete` | Only knees whose outcome at the horizon is known |
| `kl_outcomes99` | `luyten.kl_source = outcomes99` | Baseline KL 0-1 from OUTCOMES99 (V99E?XIOA != 1) |
| `koos_missing_exclude` | `luyten.koos_missing = exclude` | A knee with a missing KOOS subscale leaves the denominator |
| `progression_incidence` | `cohort.cohorts = progression_incidence` | Progression and Incidence cohorts only (no Non-exposed controls) |
| `right_knee` | `cohort.knees = right` | Right knees only |
| `roa_kl2_jsn` | `outcomes.roa_definition = kl2_jsn` | ROA = incident KL >= 2 with JSN (V99E?XIOAN) |
| `roa_replacement_ignore` | `outcomes.roa_replacement = ignore` | A knee replacement does not count as incident KL >= 2 |
| `s2_levels` | `exposure.s2_coding = levels` | Self-reported crepitus as five levels (never to always) |
| `sign_missing_exclude` | `luyten.sign_missing = exclude` | A knee with a missing clinical sign and none present leaves the denominator |
